coverage_limits: Pattern 1 coverage: every stated name and parent_company row on the 208 non-DNT records was compared with its quote; rows with words outside the quote were tested against a fresh fetch of the cited page (OSHA rows against the full record in data/osha_2025.csv) by single tokens; a second pass phrase-tested legal suffixes and read parenthetical clauses by hand on rows that passed. plants.csv name and parent values were then rebuilt so no word sits outside the field rows; owner labels were dropped from names even where a parent row states the owner (coordinator may restore them). Pages over 400k characters were truncated in the screen (Ashby board API, some Eaton and Lever pages); those rows were spot-checked with fetch_page --grep only where flagged. OSHA-cited address rows were compared to data/osha_2025.csv by record ID. Rows not on any fetched page (blank URL) were not screened.
